verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip. A user-facing feature for bulk operations across many items is a software or application capability, so this story is a category error for a processor. The evidence covers raw compute, GPU, Media Engine and ML-framework performance, and nothing shows the chip itself ships a bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
